#function to label fragment ion types
classify_fragment <- function(ion_type, base_type, fragment_sequence, modified_fragment) {
  
  ion_type <- trimws(as.character(ion_type))
  base_type <- trimws(as.character(base_type))
  modified_fragment <- trimws(as.character(modified_fragment))
  
  # Check for remainder ions
  if (ion_type %in% c("b^", "y^", "a^", "MH^")) {
    return("Remainder_ion")
  }
  
  #Check for neutal loss species
  if (ion_type %in% c("b*", "y*", "a*", "MH*")) {
    return("Remainder_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for labile ions
  if (ion_type %in% c("b~", "y~", "a~", "MH~")) {
    return("Labile_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for standard b, y, a ions (exact match)
  if (ion_type %in% c("b", "y", "a", "MH") || base_type %in% c("b", "y", "a", "MH")) {
    
    # Use modified_fragment column, not fragment_sequence
    bracket_values <- str_match_all(modified_fragment, "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]")[[1]]
    
    if (nrow(bracket_values) > 0) {
      numeric_vals <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(str_replace(bracket_values[, 2], "^\\+", ""))
      )
      numeric_vals <- numeric_vals[!is.na(numeric_vals)]
      
      if (length(numeric_vals) > 0 && any(abs(numeric_vals) > 205)) {
        return("Intact_modified_ion")
      } else {
        return("Non-modified_ion")
      }
    } else {
      return("Non-modified_ion")
    }
  }
  
  return(NA_character_)
}

# Shared theme settings
base_size           <- 12
title_text_rel_size <- 2
axis_text_rel_size  <- 1

my_theme <- theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(
                          face = "bold",
                          size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size),
                          hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text         = element_text(
                          size   = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size),
                          colour = "black"),
    axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    strip.text        = element_text(
                          face   = "bold",
                          size   = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size),
                          colour = "black"),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(
                          size   = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size),
                          colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(
                          face   = "bold",
                          size   = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size)),
    legend.position        = "right",
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    legend.key             = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

#Import data
```{r} 

####Intensity anaylsis 
data_fragments <- read.csv(file = "rescoring_results_fragments.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv(file = "rescoring_results.csv", header = TRUE)

#Bind some meta data from data to long format fragments
data_fragments <- data_fragments %>%
  left_join(
    data %>% select(Spectrum.file, index, Header, Total_Intensity, Protein, Assigned.Modifications),
    by = c(
      "Spectrum.file" = "Spectrum.file",
      "index" = "index"
    )
  )


```



```{r}

# ── Shared data prep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
graph_data <- data_fragments %>%
  filter(!grepl("rev_", Protein)) %>%
  filter(
    grepl("E|D|C-term", Assigned.Modifications)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Number_of_Mods = str_count(Assigned.Modifications, fixed("84.1054")))

graph_data <- graph_data %>%
  filter(!grepl("-NH3|-H2O", ion_type)) %>%
  mutate(
    ion_type_simple = case_when(
      grepl("\\*⁵", ion_type) ~ "Neutral loss (5 x -59)",
      grepl("\\*⁴", ion_type) ~ "Neutral loss (4 x -59)",
      grepl("\\*³", ion_type) ~ "Neutral loss (3 x -59)",
      grepl("\\*²", ion_type) ~ "Neutral loss (2 x -59)",
      grepl("\\*",  ion_type) ~ "Neutral loss (-59)",
      TRUE                    ~ "Intact"
    )
  )
write.xlsx(graph_data, file = "Table_1_matched_ion_intensity_for_AETMA_peptides.xlsx")

# Updated levels (fewest losses first for stacking order)
ion_type_levels <- c(
  "Intact",
  "Neutral loss (-59)",
  "Neutral loss (2 x -59)",
  "Neutral loss (3 x -59)",
  "Neutral loss (4 x -59)",
  "Neutral loss (5 x -59)"
)


# ── PLOT 1: Ion counts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── PLOT 2: Relative percentage abundance ────────────────────────────────────


n_per_facet <- graph_data %>%
  distinct(Number_of_Mods, index, Spectrum.file, Peptide) %>%
  group_by(Number_of_Mods) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_peptides = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Create named labeller vector
facet_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(n_per_facet$Number_of_Mods, " mod(s)\nn = ", n_per_facet$n_peptides),
  n_per_facet$Number_of_Mods
)


# ── PLOT 2: Relative percentage abundance ────────────────────────────────────

pct_data <- graph_data %>%
  group_by(Number_of_Mods, base_type, ion_type_simple) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_intensity = sum(intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Number_of_Mods, base_type) %>%
  mutate(
    pct             = total_intensity / sum(total_intensity) * 100,
    ion_type_simple = factor(ion_type_simple, levels = ion_type_levels),
    base_type       = factor(base_type,
                             levels = c("y", "b", "a", "MH"),
                             labels = c("y", "b", "a", "MH+"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_pct <- pct_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = base_type, y = pct, fill = ion_type_simple)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd", name = "Ion type", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Number_of_Mods, ncol = 5,
    labeller = labeller(Number_of_Mods = facet_labels)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "AETMA Neutral loss",
    x     = "Fragment Ion",
    y     = "Fragment Ion Relative Abundance (%)"
  ) +
  my_theme

p_pct

ggsave("Figure4A_Ion_intensities.pdf",  p_pct, dpi = 600, width =10, height = 6,device = cairo_pdf)


```


```{r}

data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(!grepl("rev_", Protein)) %>%
  filter(grepl("E|D|C-term", Assigned.Modifications)) %>%
  mutate(Number_of_Mods = str_count(Assigned.Modifications, fixed("84.1054")))

data_filtered$backbone_coverage_partial<- (data_filtered$backbone_coverage_partial/data_filtered$backbone_coverage_potential)*100
data_filtered$backbone_coverage_intact <- (data_filtered$backbone_coverage_intact/data_filtered$backbone_coverage_potential)*100

# ── Shared data prep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


coverage_long <- data_filtered %>%
  select(Number_of_Mods, Replicate, Group, Peptide, 
         backbone_coverage_partial, backbone_coverage_intact, index, Spectrum.file) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(backbone_coverage_partial, backbone_coverage_intact),
    names_to  = "coverage_type",
    values_to = "coverage_pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_type = factor(
      coverage_type,
      levels = c("backbone_coverage_intact", "backbone_coverage_partial"),
      labels = c("Intact (y/b/a)", "Partial Coverage (y/y*/b/b*/a/a*)")
    ),
    Number_of_Mods = factor(Number_of_Mods)
  )

coverage_long_rep <- coverage_long %>%
  group_by(Number_of_Mods, Replicate, coverage_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(coverage_pct = mean(coverage_pct))


# ── N peptides per facet label ────────────────────────────────────────────────

n_coverage <- coverage_long %>%
  distinct(Number_of_Mods, Peptide, Group, Replicate,  index, Spectrum.file) %>%
  group_by(Number_of_Mods) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_peptides = n(), .groups = "drop")

facet_labels_cov <- setNames(
  paste0(n_coverage$Number_of_Mods, " mod(s)\nn = ", n_coverage$n_peptides),
  n_coverage$Number_of_Mods
)

# ── Boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

p_coverage <- coverage_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = coverage_type, y = coverage_pct, fill = coverage_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    colour   = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    outlier.size  = 0.8,
    outlier.alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Coverage type") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Number_of_Mods, ncol = 5,
    labeller = labeller(Number_of_Mods = facet_labels_cov)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Backbone Sequence Coverage by Number of Modifications",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Backbone coverage (%)"
  ) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

p_coverage


ggsave("Figure4B_backbone_coverage.pdf",  p_coverage, dpi = 600, width =10, height = 6,device = cairo_pdf)


```
